text:
</sub>  Seed a demonstrably lossy external-output contract

The `external-output-parsing-lossy` fixture never establishes that non-`- ` lines represent valid items, so `classifyItems` may simply be a correct parser for a bullet-list format. Neither the patch nor a caller supplies mixed-format input that this function is required to preserve; consequently, a model can identify the expected defect only by assuming or parroting the sweep category, making the committed recall measurements for this required real-theme seed invalid. Add an explicit external-output grammar or caller/example containing valid items that this implementation actually loses or merges.
